description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of various models, comparing their relative effectiveness. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with model names including Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS, in a specific order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance" and has a linear scale ranging from 10 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each model is represented by a bar of a distinct color: orange for the first model (partially labeled), tan for Self-RAG, light green for FactTune, blue for CInGS (w/), and dark blue for CInGS. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and their heights correspond to the average performance values. The approximate values of the bars are: around 58 for the first model, 62 for Self-RAG, 64 for FactTune, 68 for CInGS (w/), and 72 for CInGS. The bars are sorted in ascending order of their heights, with the shortest bar on the left and the tallest on the right. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color representation.
